body:
Do not cache a bound query across concurrent calls or share destination variables between independently built queries. Shared derived-query guards detect overlaps only within that guard family, and struct-literal Query values have no guard. Build per call or use a correctly allocated Reader. Copy Each callback values before retaining them.

Evidence: ds:block?id=query-ownership-vsv882ny; ds:block?id=query-overlap-5hddx8sm; ds:block?id=bound-each-qvvzm6tq; ds:block?id=reader-sharing-79k4pyx5. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
title: Execution guards do not own arbitrary caller memory
